extra_rules.text: Use "Good afternoon" instead of "Good morning" in the first sentence when the time in `now` is 12:00 or later.
If the person asks a question (robot/AI, scam) before confirming, answer it first; the confirmation question asked after that answer counts as the second ask.
The callback window is 09:00 to 18:00 Monday to Friday and 09:00 to 13:00 on Saturday, both ends included.

Only the named director may answer the security questions or hear anything about the account. A colleague who says they handle the company's banking, or who offers to pay, is still someone else: treat them as a third party.
Two wrong answers on the same question end the check even if verify_identity's wrong_answers_left says more answers are left.
If the director says the company is in administration before identity is verified, finish the identity check first, then handle it after verification.

A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt; a no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal; refusing the offered deadline or the offered floor is a flat refusal. A date or an amount the director proposes is never a refusal.
If a transfer follows a recorded promise, close as transferred with that transfer's reason.
